title: Vividly Crispy American Cheese Sandwich
description: A malty, crispy, lazy-sunday American dish featuring cheese slices on double-rise-bread, cooked to perfection on a comal.
instructions: Preheat a comal or griddle over medium heat.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
In a small bowl, mix together malted milk powder, salt, and black pepper.
Sprinkle the malted milk mixture evenly over the buttered side of two bread slices.
Place one bread slice, buttered side down, on the comal.
Place one or two American cheese slices on top of the bread slice on the comal.
Place the second bread slice, buttered side up, on top of the cheese slices.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Carefully flip the sandwich over and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
